notes.title: Ascendant Dawn 0.12.3
notes.notes: [p]I've worked on adding quality of life changes to make playing Ascendant Dawn easier and more enjoyable. There are also a load of optimisations as well and more graphics settings.[/p][p][/p][h2]Additions:[/h2][list][*][p]Mounted troops now need livestock of a certain type and those livestock need to be of sufficient strength. This is done via selectively breeding your livestock.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Tribal nobles now generate a new default troop.[/p][/*][*][p]New background area, the mountains have been replaced with a landscape[/p][/*][*][p]When interacting with an animal resource or livestock changes are shown[/p][/*][*][p]The tutorial has been much improved[/p][/*][*][p]A popup event teaching about popup events[/p][/*][*][p]Added cloud shadows[/p][/*][*][p]The sun now doesn't go directly overhead meaning there are always some shadows.[/p][/*][*][p]New landscape textures[/p][/*][*][p]Added particle effects to the desert[/p][/*][*][p]A few new settlement buildings[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Fixes:[/h2][list][*][p]Improved appearance of settlement walls LODs[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed deer sometimes appearing as camels[/p][/*][*][p]Camera homing has been fixed[/p][/*][*][p]AI Armies now work better[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Quality of Life[/h2][p][/p][list][*][p]Sharpened Camera Movement[/p][/*][*][p]The camera now goes over mountains[/p][/*][*][p]Tutorial widgets now consume clicks[/p][/*][*][p]Clicking to move the tribe starts the game moving[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]More tooltips[/p][/*][*][p]Improved controls feeling[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]There are a few other small changes that should make your experiences better.[/p][p][/p][h2]Optimisation[/h2][p]For optimisation a lot of people have been complaining about the performance of unreal engine games, which Ascendant Dawn is, so I've ensured that it's well optimised. Before this update the CPU was the bottle neck and there were a load of inefficient functions I optimised. For the graphics I've added billboards for trees, ensured good LODs and worked on graphical effects to minimise their impact. I've also added a few more graphics settings to give players more granular control over their graphics. [/p][p]This should mean that if you have the recommended hardware then you should get around 120fps.[/p][p]If you have an older GPU I'd like to hear how well it performs.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Ascendant Dawn 0.12.1 Update
notes.notes: [p]I've added some new content, fixed some bugs and most importantly I've implemented the save system in the demo. Currently, it's a little bare bones with just the ability to create(including overwrite) and load saves. I'm going to be adding other features such as the ability to delete saves and for the UI to give context on what's in the save and information such as when it was created. There's almost certainly some bugs with the saving system so if you find any report them on the steam forum or discord.[/p][p][/p][p]Below is a changelog with most of the changes though I haven't included everything.[/p][p][/p][p]-Changed riverbed texture[/p][p]-Added ridge hills to part of the map[/p][p]-Replacing mountains with new spline based mountains[/p][p]-Added a new technology shock troops[/p][p]-Club and axe brutes now require the new shock troops technology[/p][p]-Raiders now require the technology bronze working[/p][p]-Fixed a bug where only 2 digits would show for the troop number in the tribal army UI[/p][p]-Fixed a bug where the winter freezing sound would play times at once[/p][p]-Improved some of appearances of assets when they are close to the camera.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Ascendant Dawn 0.11.2
notes.notes: [p]This update is mainly bug fixes and other small improvements.[/p][p][/p][p]-Upgrading a building now has requirements[/p][p]-Culture traditions are now integrated for settled gameplay.[/p][p]-Store houses now protect 1000 resources instead of 500[/p][p]-Fixed a bug where the inputs would not be flushed when hovering over UI which could lead to the camera continuing to move after the user stops moving it.[/p][p]-FPS counter in pause settings no longer has the visual bug.[/p][p]-Buzzard audio changed.[/p][p]-You can no longer promote slaves to priests or judges.[/p][p]-Cattle give less food.[/p][p]-Pops are easier to please.[/p][p]-A general decrease in required resources.[/p][p]-Decreased the number of slaves in most cities, they would sometimes build up.[/p][p]-Added proper icons to army and settler UIs.[/p][p]-Decreased the number of tier 1 techs making it easier to progress.[/p][p][/p][p]There are a few other small changes that I haven't written here as they are too minor.[/p]

notes.title: Ascendant Dawn 0.11
notes.notes: [p]Over the past few weeks, I’ve been working to get the settled gameplay up to a good standard, though I’m sure there are still a few bugs which if you report I’ll be happy to fix.[/p][p][/p][h1]Settlement[/h1][p][/p][p]It's now possible to play as a settled nation to do so you must play through the demo and obtain the permanent settlement technology which required bronze working then traders then coinage as a prerequisite, which can take some time in the mean time build up your tribe in other ways.[/p][p]There are a few places on the map that you can choose to settle in all close to each other as I wanted the experience to be similar regardless of where you settle. On settlement you get to create a new faction and pick your colour, though the UI for that could potentially use some improvements as sliders are used to select which colour to use.[/p][p]I decided that creating a settlement should be a significant endeavour that you need to prepare for by saving up significant food and authority. I plan to add several events related to the settlement of a town however these haven’t been implemented yet and would require even more authority.[/p][p]The building system is simple yet punishing and microing is required to get the full potential from your settlement. Each building either has benefits like authority production, or it can be used for production. Both types take in resources and required population to work in them and in exchange give their benefits or production outputs. Having only some of the resources or only partially filling the work force will result in less output, in the case where one of the required resources is missing completely nothing will be produced which differs to say Victoria 3’s factories which can produce despite missing core resources, if at a slow rate.[/p][p][/p][h1]Trade and Resources[/h1][p]This means that as a player you must be aware of the resource requirements and what you currently have. It is virtually impossible for a settlement, unless very large, to produce every required resource especially when many resources are available only in different regions such as copper and tin. To aid in this the player can move workers between different buildings easily allowing for you to build up a bank of one resource to use later. An even better way is to trade, either between your own settlements or with other factions. Each settlement has a max number of trade links it can support, and goods are moved from where they are cheapest to where they are more expensive based on demand. So, if you have a town with 3 farms and another with a flax field and 2 potters then food would be cheaper in the first and be traded to the second. Pottery would be traded to the first and textiles being produced in both would be traded slightly to the first as it produces less. This means that with long enough trade routs a valuable and expensive item such as purple dye will slowly move all over the map to be consumed.[/p][p][/p][h1]Quality of Life[/h1][p][/p][p]I've been updating the tutorial world space to increase the variety of areas in the play space as well as what can be done in the tutorial. For instance, the lake areas and new coastal planes.[/p][p][/p][p]There's also a fair few small changes, with more coming in subsequent minor updates. One thing I've been working on is the the UI readability. I've been adding tooltips and adding nicer looking and more uniform icons. As an experiment I added one in the new style to the building icons (the sacred grove) I'd love to hear if people prefer that style or the yellow and black style present in the rest of the icons.[/p][p][/p][p]I hope you enjoy this update and building your new empire.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Ascendant Dawn 0.10.0
notes.notes:
I've updated Ascendant Dawn with some new features both visual and mechanical.
Below is a list though there are other small changes I've made that aren't included.

-Added the Gol Swamps region. These are several lakes splitting up the starting region.
-Changed the appearance of rivers and added fords.
-Updated the army AI
-The game now starts in mid spring rather than mid summer this means that snows come later.
-Added a temple bound to Ilios as a dynamic on map building.
-Added seasonal vegetation like bluebells, mushrooms, leaves changing colour and buttercups.
-Added succession traditions. Either choose primogeniture or meritocratic. 
-Added more rocks to the desert landscape. 
-Added the ability to talk to settlements but it's disabled in this build and just the option is available.
-Made some tweaks to various systems.

notes.title: Version 0.9
notes.notes:
0.9 adds some visual elements to the map. None of them have gameplay impacts but they do reflect the state of nearby settlements.

- Added roads between settlements and wood resources

- Added farmland that grows or shrinks depending on the number of farms in a nearby settlement

- Added ranches that grow or shrink depending on the number of ranches in a nearby settlement

- Added small settlements how's size is dependent on the number of trade connections present in nearby settlements.

notes.title: 0.8.4 Update
notes.notes:
-Improved settings menu
-Added more tooltips to the HUD
-Changed the day and night speed. Days now move slower and nights faster. This can all the customised within the settings.
-Removed hard pausing on events so music now doesn't stop during them.

If you notice any bugs or have any recommendations please inform me.
